widgets_values: A lighthouse keeper in a yellow oilskin coat climbs the last steps of a spiral iron staircase and pushes open the door to the lantern room. Rain streams down the curved glass, the great lens turns slowly behind him and its beam sweeps across the dark sea. He wipes the glass with his sleeve and looks out at a ship's lights in the distance. The camera follows him up the stairs from behind, then circles slowly to his profile. Cold blue storm light mixed with the warm amber of the lamp. Sound of heavy rain on glass, wind howling around the tower, the low hum and click of the rotating lens, his breathing after the climb.

## LTX-2.5: text, first frame and last frame to video, two stages

[LTX-2.5](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5) (Lightricks, 22B, Gemma 4 text encoder) generates video and
stereo audio together.

**Settings** (distilled): stage 1 with 8 fixed sigmas, stage 2 with 3, CFG 1, euler_ancestral. **Width** and
**Height** are the stage 1 size (sides multiples of 32); stage 2 doubles it in latent space (640×352 → 1280×704).
**Length (frames)** is 8n+1 (121 ≈ 5 s at 24 fps, up to about 10 s per shot), **Frame rate** feeds the
conditioning, the audio latent and the video.

## Image Bench

| Marker | Node | Generate tab |
|--------|------|--------------|
| `ib:cp` | Load Diffusion Model | model list |
| `ib:pp` | Image Bench Prompt | prompt and LoRA list |
| `ib:smp` | Stage 1 sampler | seed (RandomNoise), sampling method (KSamplerSelect), size (Empty LTXV Latent Video) |
| `ib:smp:1` | Stage 2 sampler | Hires. fix group |
| `ib:hr` | Stage 2 (If/Else Switch, video and audio) | Hires. fix checkbox; switched on by the Upscale button |
| `ib:ref:0` | First frame (bypassed) | References panel, first image |
| `ib:ref:1` | Last frame (bypassed) | References panel, second image |
| `ib:ext` | Extend from video (bypassed) | "Extend video" image action |
| `ib:lora` | Load LoRA (bypassed) | LoRA exploration only |

**Length (frames)** and **Frame rate** are the fields of the Video tab (beside Sampling); Frames keeps 8n+1.

**Hires. fix** is stage 2: off, the stage 1 video at the Generate tab size is saved (a fast draft) and stage 2
does not run; on, it is upscaled 2× and refined. Steps are fixed sigma lists, so the steps fields stay hidden.

**Frames**: the first image of the References panel is the first frame (written into the latent, strength 0.7 in
stage 1, 1.0 in stage 2), the second one the last frame (a guide at frame -1, removed again by **LTXV Crop
Guides** after each stage). An empty slot is bypassed with its nodes.

The negative prompt does nothing at CFG 1 and is not marked. The official templates add a prompt enhancer
(Gemma 4 E2B, **TextGenerateLTX2Prompt**); here the prompt goes to the encoder as written, so write it in
full: subject, action, camera, light, then the sound.

**Extend video**: the "Extend video" action (X) of a video card loads it into **Extend from video**: its last 17
frames (**Image From Batch**) become a guide at frame 0 in both stages (**Extend guide**), so the new clip
continues it. Describe what happens next in the prompt. The new clip begins with those 17 frames; join the clips
in an editor. The References panel lists the video as "Extends"; remove it there to bypass the group again.

## Model Links

Accept the license of [Lightricks/LTX-2.5](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5) first.

**diffusion_models**: [ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/resolve/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors)
**text_encoders**: [gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/resolve/main/text_encoders/gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors)
**vae**: [ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/resolve/main/vae/ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors), [ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/resolve/main/vae/ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors)
